Since 1984, Plasticase — the company behind NANUK — has been engineering hard cases with a single obsession: make them indestructible. Canada's harsh climate and demanding industrial standards create the ideal proving ground for cases that need to perform when failure isn't an option. Every case in the lineup — from compact Nano cases to large wheeled hard cases — is built with the same core commitments…
